csv_scope_of_work: The Georgia Department of Transportation (GDOT) is soliciting Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) from a qualified firm(s) to provide Construction Engineering and Inspection (CEI) services. The Consultant shall provide Construction Engineering and Inspection (CEI) Services for District 4 Tifton, which are required for contract administration, inspection, and materials sampling and testing for the construction projects assigned to the Valdosta, Douglas, Donalsonville, Moultrie, and Albany Area Offices. Some of the projects may require night and weekend inspection. The project types may include new construction, widening and reconstruction, rehabilitation of asphalt and concrete pavement, bridge replacement, and resurfacing.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Inspection Services, Materials Testing, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering

short_description: CEI services for GDOT roadway, pavement, and bridge construction projects in southwest Georgia.
project_location: Atlanta, Georgia, USA; services for GDOT District 4 Tifton area offices including Valdosta, Douglas, Donalsonville, Moultrie, and Albany.
project_scope: Provision of construction engineering and inspection services for multiple transportation construction projects assigned to GDOT District 4 Tifton area offices. Project types may include new construction, widening and reconstruction, rehabilitation of asphalt and concrete pavement, bridge replacement, and resurfacing. Services include contract administration, inspection, and materials sampling and testing; some assignments may require night and weekend inspection. No specific bridge spans, lengths, or building areas are stated.
services: Construction Engineering and Inspection (CEI) services including contract administration, site inspection, materials sampling and testing, and support for transportation construction projects; disciplines requested include civil engineering, structural engineering, inspection services, materials testing, traffic design engineering, environmental engineering/planning/design, landscape architecture, and construction/project management.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a CEI/inspection and contract administration procurement, not core structural design.
- Covers general highway and pavement works with unspecified bridge replacement components.
- No defined structurally ambitious bridge or special structure is described.
- Includes structural engineering among requested disciplines, but planning/design scope is limited.
- Framework-like multi-project service nature reduces relevance for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents as contract value 100.0K; this appears to refer to the consultant contract value, not overall construction cost, so the actual construction cost of the underlying works is not stated.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee for sbp-type services is stated. The only monetary figure given is a 100.0K contract value for CEI services, which is not an sbp structural design fee.
references_qualifications: Qualified firms are sought to provide CEI services. Requested disciplines include landscape architecture, civil engineering, construction/project management, inspection services, materials testing, environmental engineering/planning/design, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering. Specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided text.
